item_short_desc: Proudly display your veteran status with Rothco’s Veteran Low Profile Cap. Featuring an embroidered U.S. flag and “Veteran” text on the front panel, this cap offers a sleek and timeless design. Made from lightweight and durable brushed cotton twill, the cap ensures maximum comfort for all-day wear. The adjustable hook and loop strap, complete with a “Veteran” woven label, provides a secure and personalized fit. An internal sweatband helps keep sweat out of your eyes.
